assets.name: rock_face_03 (cliff surface material)
assets.author: Poly Haven; Dario Barresi (photography), Rico Cilliers (processing)

assets.name: Modular Urban Apartments Facade (window modules)
assets.author: Poly Haven
assets.modified: Window modules photographed orthographically into colour, normal, roughness, metalness and depth maps, and set into every wall family's bay sheet (r1/windows.py, r1/surfaces.py)

assets.name: Flowering Cherry Tree — user-selected Innerscene sakura
assets.author: Innerscene
assets.modified: Normalized to 1 metre; authored Near geometry retained and merged by material; Mid retains complete flowers/leaves selected by coverage; relightable Far atlas baked from Mid. Fixed flowering appearance, no phenology simulation.

assets.name: Pine Tree Tall — adult conifer
assets.title: Pine Tree Tall
assets.author: TerrainTale; ambientCG; ez-tree by Daniel Greenheck
assets.modified: Normalized LOD0; exact needle crown in Mid with UV-aware bark reduction; 160-view camera-facing Far baked directly from LOD0 with 50% coverage cutoff, 192px per view

assets.name: Road motorcycle — Innerscene
assets.author: Innerscene
assets.modifications: Pinned source models, reduced Near/Far geometry with preserved textures and smooth shading; +Z forward, independent wheel pivots and separated paint/rubber/metal materials.

assets.name: Dirt motorcycle — Innerscene
assets.author: Innerscene
assets.modifications: Pinned source models, reduced Near/Far geometry with preserved textures and smooth shading; +Z forward, independent wheel pivots and separated paint/rubber/metal materials.

assets.name: Photographed low vegetation (depth-sliced)
assets.author: Rico Cilliers / Poly Haven
assets.modified: Individual plants assembled into asymmetric clumps; depth-sliced 176/44-triangle geometry, albedo/alpha/object normals/hemisphere visibility baked from scans; senescent grass recolour. Source lock: tools/r1/understory_sources.json.

assets.name: Parachute — Poly by Google
assets.author: Poly by Google
assets.modifications: Kite bar removed and line ends brought onto the shoulders; painted texture replaced by five flat measured-albedo materials (red, yellow, blue and black ripstop, white lines); front at +Z (the wing is symmetric fore and aft). Geometry otherwise as downloaded.
